# M0-S2: .lgo test files are discovered; mixed .go test files are rejected.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Pure .lgo package with a .lgo test runs.
logos test ./ok
stdout '^ok'
! stdout 'no test files'

# .lgo beside .go test file fails.
! logos test ./mix
stderr 'correctness::mixed_package'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/t

go 1.27

-- ok/p.lgo --
package ok

func Add(a, b int) int { return a + b }

-- ok/p_test.lgo --
package ok

import "testing"

func TestAdd(t *testing.T) {
	if Add(1, 2) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("bad add")
	}
}

-- mix/p.lgo --
package mix

func Add(a, b int) int { return a + b }

-- mix/p_test.go --
package mix

import "testing"

func TestAdd(t *testing.T) {
	if Add(1, 2) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("bad add")
	}
}
